description: This file defines the ClientService interface in Java, which outlines methods for managing Client entities, including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations within a CRM system.

classes.name: ClientService
classes.description: Interface defining the service layer for Client management operations.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object based on its unique identifier.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object based on the company's name.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Client objects.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Returns a list of possible client status strings.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Saves a Client object and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a Client based on its ID.

methods.name: saveClientWithLoggedUser
methods.description: Saves a Client with the currently logged-in User managing the client.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds clients managed by a specific User.
